About

S-WAYS Ai solutions operates at the intersection of creative direction, generative AI and engineered production pipelines. Our focus is delivering controlled, photorealistic visual assets for commercial briefs where real products enter generated environments with matched perspective, light and shadow.

Founded by Syed Sana Haseen with a team of AI artists and video editors, backed by a fine arts foundation and continuous hands-on generative AI production since 2023. Every pipeline is engineered for repeatability: zero random prompts, zero product drift.

Most production runs inside ComfyUI: reference-conditioned generation, multi-angle product editing, retouching and compositing, paired with in-house LoRA training when a campaign demands lockstep consistency. Emerging open and closed tools are benchmarked the week they ship and automated via Hermes, Codex and Claude Code.

Every case study on this site is documented the way S-WAYS works: real models, real parameters, real obstacles and the ComfyUI graphs engineered to clear them.

Studio Delivery Model

Direction & Reference Lock, Phase 01 · Pre-Production

Isolation & Layout · 01 / Brief → Reference Pack

Product geometry, proportions, label specs, and camera/light direction locked before a single frame generates.

  • Source product extraction and multi-angle reference packs.
  • 3D environment blocking and camera blocking in Blender via MCP when a shot requires exact perspective.
  • Lighting mood boards, palette targets, and format aspect specs mapped upfront.

ComfyUI & LoRA Engineering, Phase 02 · Generation

Control & Consistency · 02 / Open-Source First → Custom Controls

Modular node graphs, in-house character and style LoRAs, and deterministic seed/sampler sweeps built for zero drift.

  • Multi-reference conditioning and instruction-guided editing inside ComfyUI.
  • Custom character, product, and style LoRA training with strict dataset curation.
  • Agent-driven batch queuing and parameter sweeps across local GPU pipelines.

Commercial Polish & Delivery, Phase 03 · Finishing

Upscale & Multi-Format · 03 / Composite → Grade → Ship

Physical product compositing, shadow grounding, high-res upscaling, and native aspect adaptation for every placement.

  • Relighting, contact shadow integration, and texture-preserving upscales.
  • Unified color grading across full still sets and AI video cuts.
  • Native 16:9 hero, 4:5 mobile, 1:1 catalogue, and 9:16 social deliverables.

What We Solve

Production-ready AI image and video systems for commercial product and lifestyle advertising, product fidelity, compositing and repeatable workflows.

  • Product Fidelity, Maintaining recognizable product shape, proportions, materials and details.
  • Photorealistic Environments, Creating believable commercial environments around existing products.
  • Lighting Matching, Matching key light direction, softness, intensity and color temperature.
  • Perspective Matching, Aligning camera angle, scale and product placement with the environment.
  • Controlled AI Generation, Using references, prompting and workflow controls to produce consistent results.
  • Production Variations, Creating multiple useful assets from one visual system and adapting them across formats.

Where AI Meets Image Craft

A model gets you close. These are the controls that make the output a commercial deliverable.

  • Product Fidelity, Keeping the physical characteristics of the source product intact through generation and compositing.
  • Lighting, Matching key light direction, softness, intensity and color temperature to the world around the product.
  • Perspective, Aligning camera height, angle and scale so the product sits in the room instead of on top of it.
  • Materials, Reading fabric, wood, stone and glass as physical materials, texture, sheen and micro-detail intact.
  • Composition, Framing every asset for where it will live: hero, feed, banner, product page, mobile.
  • Consistency, Holding one product, one look and one grade across an entire set, not just one hero frame.

Futuristic Neon Chase · MCP Blender env → Seedance 2.5

S-WAYS Ai solutions · Concept · 2026 · concept

A neon chase built in two passes: the environment, rider and camera path were made in Blender with the agent driving it over MCP and baked to a clean clay render, then Seedance 2.5 turned that pass into the final cinematic motion picture.
